map.固有频率低代表什么？: What does a low natural frequency mean?
map.质量大或刚度小则固有频率低，越容易隔离高频扰动（隔振比更高）。: Larger mass or lower stiffness lowers the natural frequency, making it easier to isolate high-frequency disturbance (higher isolation ratio).
map.和音频声学有什么关系？: How does this relate to audio acoustics?
map.结构振动会辐射声波，固有频率决定结构噪声的主要频段，是声学设计的耦合点。: Structural vibration radiates sound, and the natural frequency sets the main band of structural noise, making it a coupling point in acoustic design.
